attchmntText: Balu Forge Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates - Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Balu Forge Industries Limited submitted its investor presentation for Q2 and H1 FY2027. The company reported H1 FY2027 revenue of Rs.625 crore, up 17%, and PAT of Rs.143 crore, up 17%. Q2 FY2027 revenue was Rs.324.3 crore, with PAT at Rs.76.6 crore. The order book stands at Rs.2,400 crore, with Defence, Aerospace, and Railways contributing nearly 50%. The company is expanding forging capacity to 168,000 MTPA and precision machining to 80,000 MTPA. A new ring rolling line acquisition is set for trials before end of December 2026. The promoter group has proposed an investment of up to Rs.162 crore through the allotment of 30,00,000 preferential warrants at a floor price of Rs.540 per warrant. Proceeds will fund capex, balance sheet strengthening, and general corporate purposes.

attchmntText: Balu Forge Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about issue of Securities by way of Preferential issue to convertible warrants
voiceSummary: Balu Forge Industries Limited approved unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Net profit after tax was 4,255.22 lakh for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and 8,504.45 lakh for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board proposed increasing authorized share capital from 125 crore to 132 crore by creating 70 lakh additional equity shares of 10 rupees each, subject to shareholder approval. The company also proposed raising funds by issuing up to 30 lakh warrants to promoters at 540 rupees per warrant, aggregating up to 162 crore, subject to shareholder and stock exchange approvals. An Extra-Ordinary General Meeting is scheduled for December 12, 2026, to seek approval for these matters. M/s Jaymin Modi & Co. has been appointed as the scrutinizer for the e-voting process.

attchmntText: Balu Forge Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Press Release on Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Balu Forge Industries Limited submitted its press release regarding un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for H1 FY27 reached Rs. 625.1 crore, up 17.3% year-on-year. Profit after tax grew 16.9% to Rs. 142.7 crore. EBITDA stood at Rs. 178.5 crore with a margin of 28.6%. Operating cash flow rose seven times to Rs. 245 crore. Receivables reduced by Rs. 31.2 crore. Net debt-to-equity remained at 0.04x. Promoters committed Rs. 162 crore in investments. The company expects 25 to 30% revenue growth in FY27.

attchmntText: Balu Forge Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026.
voiceSummary: Balu Forge Industries Limited approved unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Net profit after tax stood at 4,752.52 lakh for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and 8,504.45 lakh for the half year. The Board proposed increasing authorized share capital from 125 crore to 132 crore rupees by creating 70 lakh additional equity shares of 10 rupees each. This increase is subject to shareholder approval. The company also proposed raising funds by issuing up to 30 lakh warrants to promoters at 540 rupees per warrant, aggregating up to 162 crore rupees. This preferential issue is subject to shareholder approval, in-principle stock exchange approval, and other regulatory consents. An Extra-Ordinary General Meeting is scheduled for December 12, 2026, to seek these approvals. The statutory auditors noted machinery advances from a wholly owned subsidiary exceeding prescribed timelines and ongoing block assessment proceedings by the Income Tax Department.
